name: Warner Bros. Discovery
description: Warner Bros. Discovery owns one of Hollywood's big film and TV studios (Warner Bros., DC, Harry Potter), the HBO and HBO Max streaming services (131.6 million subscribers at the end of 2025), and a large portfolio of TV networks (CNN, HGTV, Food Network and others). Streaming earns subscription and ad revenue, Studios earns from films, TV production and licensing, and the Global Linear Networks earn fees from cable and satellite distributors plus advertising; that last business is the profit pool (62 percent of segment EBITDA in 2025) but shrinking (EBITDA down 21 percent in 2025). The company has agreed to be acquired for cash by Paramount Skydance (PSKY) for $31.00 a share after ending an earlier Netflix deal in February 2026; twelve state attorneys general and two writers' guilds sued in July 2026 to block it.
